body.fontFamily: Raft Quote Glyphs, Space Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif

stateEvidence.default: desktop channel, workspace roots, and mobile roots observed
stateEvidence.hover: desktop global search control measured with a real pointer
stateEvidence.focus: desktop server switcher reached by Tab and measured with a 3px outline
stateEvidence.pressed: desktop selected navigation control measured during real pointer press
stateEvidence.selected: desktop aria-pressed navigation and mobile yellow primary item measured
stateEvidence.disabled: empty channel Composer send control measured
stateEvidence.loading: visible initial channel loading text observed; deterministic slow-server capture remains a matrix gap
stateEvidence.error: deterministic OpenTag auth, bootstrap, search, activity, saved, tasks, files, members, profile, and settings transport failures were captured; unavailable reference failures are recorded as product differences rather than parity
stateEvidence.empty: empty Search, Activity, Saved, task, member, integration, and MCP-capability outcomes were exercised without substituting reference private data
stateEvidence.no-results: Search with a stable unmatched query rendered a distinct no-results result rather than an error or perpetual loading state
stateEvidence.open: notification dialog and thread preview observed
stateEvidence.closed: dialog remains mounted but not visible after Escape
stateEvidence.scrolled: channel timeline internal scroll observed while body stayed fixed

licenses.surface: reference fonts, icons, logo, and brand colors
licenses.decision: measurement only; do not copy without a verified license
licenses.requiredFallback: record exact visual delta and use licensed OpenTag-owned assets
